_about: Every raw read of the turn pointer (order[turnIndex], actingCombatantId, currentPcId) outside held-turn.ts and can-act.ts, by file: its count and why it reads the bare pointer. Whether it is someone's own turn is asked of ownTurnOf (src/lib/dm/held-turn.ts). Held by scripts/test-turn-pointer-readers.mjs.

app/api/campaigns/[campaignId]/actions/r.why: currentPcId tags a played line with the initiative slot the floor is on; held turns are refused by the act's own door

app/api/campaigns/[campaignId]/battle-ma.why: asks enemiesAhead (the held turn) itself just above; this read names whose turn it is

app/api/campaigns/[campaignId]/companion.why: the initiative floor follows the pointer itself (the seat whose turn it is), and the held turn's own rule is the floor's

app/campaigns/[campaignId]/BattleMapPane.why: client screen: shows whose place the pointer is at (a screen, a name in a sentence), asking nothing of the turn

app/campaigns/[campaignId]/CinematicPart.why: client screen: shows whose place the pointer is at (a screen, a name in a sentence), asking nothing of the turn

app/campaigns/[campaignId]/Composer.tsx.why: client screen: shows whose place the pointer is at (a screen, a name in a sentence), asking nothing of the turn

app/campaigns/[campaignId]/DmInitiativeP.why: client screen: shows whose place the pointer is at (a screen, a name in a sentence), asking nothing of the turn

app/campaigns/[campaignId]/MonsterHand.t.why: client screen: shows whose place the pointer is at (a screen, a name in a sentence), asking nothing of the turn

lib/agents/webhooks.ts.why: an agent program's status reports the pointer's entry as it stands

lib/battlemap/initiative-rows.ts.why: the initiative strip's highlighted row: shows whose place the pointer is at (a screen, a name in a sentence), asking nothing of the turn

lib/battlemap/view.ts.why: the board view's pointer for the public projection; the held turn is sent beside it

lib/character-seat.ts.why: currentPcId itself (defined here) and the seat the floor's slot names

lib/db/encounter-view.ts.why: the public encounter's current entry: shows whose place the pointer is at (a screen, a name in a sentence), asking nothing of the turn

lib/db/encounters.ts.why: turnKey: the pointer's own mechanics: advancing it, splicing the order, the turn's key

lib/dm/attack-record.ts.why: attackTurnOver: a parked roll's turn by the pointer and the round it was rolled in, not a new act

lib/dm/authored-saves.ts.why: actingSheetId reads the entry and asks ownTurnOf of it

lib/dm/claims.ts.why: the acting combatant's budget key and the turn finalize hands on: the pointer's own mechanics: advancing it, splicing the order, the turn's key

lib/dm/companion-command.ts.why: whose companion turn the GM plays: the floor's slot

lib/dm/departure-turn.ts.why: reads the entry and asks ownTurnOf of it for the pact's own turn

lib/dm/encounter-tools.ts.why: the pointer machinery itself (advancePointer, end_turn and the move it holds for a watcher's stop, the order, death saves at a turn's start); end_turn handles the held turn itself

lib/dm/enemy-actions-view.ts.why: a legendary creature's onPointer reading: the pointer never rests on an enemy

lib/dm/enemy-turn-order.ts.why: names whose turn it is in an enemy's refusal

lib/dm/foresight-more.ts.why: the pointer move's own saves (moveSavesAbout): who is leaving as End Turn moves the pointer, and the dying it reaches next

lib/dm/initiative-ask.ts.why: the console's words name the first in the order

lib/dm/initiative-edit.ts.why: editing the order: the pointer's own mechanics: advancing it, splicing the order, the turn's key

lib/dm/initiative-floor.ts.why: the initiative floor follows the pointer itself (the seat whose turn it is), and the held turn's own rule is the floor's

lib/dm/initiative.ts.why: locking and walking the order: the pointer's own mechanics: advancing it, splicing the order, the turn's key

lib/dm/last-hit.ts.why: lateFor asks turnStart and the pass itself

lib/dm/last-save.ts.why: actedThisTurn reads the acting entry's budget (moved here from last-hit.ts): whether the creature whose turn it is has done anything yet, not whose turn it is

lib/dm/legendary-tools.ts.why: a legendary creature's onPointer reading: the pointer never rests on an enemy

lib/dm/mount-tools.ts.why: names whose turn it is in the refusal; the turn itself is asked of ownTurnOf

lib/dm/pc-attack-gate.ts.why: asks heldTurnRefusal and releasesReadiedOffTurn beside it; the other read only asks whether a fight's order is running

lib/dm/player-word.ts.why: the character whose player's word the AI's call waits on: the floor's slot (the GM is shown the enemies due beside it)

lib/dm/reaction-counters.ts.why: splices an extra turn after the pointer: the pointer's own mechanics: advancing it, splicing the order, the turn's key

lib/dm/reaction-triggers.ts.why: triggerRecords names the creature whose turn has just begun, for a turn-start trigger: who the pointer is on, not whether it is their own turn

lib/dm/stand-up.ts.why: names whose turn it is in the refusal; the turn itself is asked of ownTurnOf

lib/dm/summon-store.ts.why: keeps the pointer on its entry when a summon leaves the order: the pointer's own mechanics: advancing it, splicing the order, the turn's key

lib/dm/swallow.ts.why: turnRunning asks turnStart and the pass itself

lib/dm/turn-budget.ts.why: currentCombatantId: the budget's owner, the pointer's own mechanics: advancing it, splicing the order, the turn's key

lib/dm/turn-owner.ts.why: returns the pointer's entry with the enemies due beside it

lib/dm/turn.ts.why: the AI turn's prompt and its pointer step: the pointer's own mechanics: advancing it, splicing the order, the turn's key
